title: The ECSS package of MPSCring: what it holds and how it maps to the rms
body: The package's overview: the customer and the supplier, the documents and their reviews, the items as CSVs in the rms import format, the references, the open items.
rationale: One page says where every document and item of MPSCRING comes from.
criteria: The review of the milestone accepts it.

title: Tailoring statement and criticality classification
body: Category B proposed from kyr_core's use (every durable write of the box crosses the ring), the tailoring of ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 and ECSS-Q-ST-80C Rev.2 for a one-file C library, the document set and its reviews.
rationale: ECSS-Q-ST-80 6.2.2 (software criticality); ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex R and Annex S.
criteria: The SRR accepts the proposal; the customer confirms the category.

title: Software system specification (SSS): what the platform requires of the ring
body: The customer's requirements on the software, as the platform states them from kyr_core's write queue: every job handed from any request thread to its environment's one writer, exactly once, never lost while admitted; a bounded admission; batches; the delivery.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2: the requirements baseline is the customer's output.
criteria: The SRR agrees the requirements baseline.
notes: file=RB; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex B; reviews=SRR; path=ecss/RB/SSS.md

title: Interface requirements document (IRD) toward MPSCring
body: The interface the platform requires of the ring: the C calls kyr_core's write queue makes, their statuses, the thread roles, the publication order, the linkage.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2.4.3a: the interface requirements are the customer's output, part of the requirements baseline.
criteria: The SRR agrees the requirements baseline.
notes: file=RB; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex C; reviews=SRR; path=ecss/RB/IRD.md

title: Statement of work: the write queue's ring for the platform
body: What the platform asks of the supplier: the library, its documents after ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 and ECSS-Q-ST-80C Rev.2, the reviews SRR to QR, the release pinned by the platform.
rationale: The contract's part of the requirements baseline (ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2).
criteria: The SRR agrees the requirements baseline.

title: Software requirements specification (SRS)
body: The supplier's requirements of MPSCring 1.0.10: creation (owned and caller-owned storage), capacity, order, refusal, the per-slot sequence protocol, memory ordering, progress (and its limit), lock-free atomics, queries, delivery; each derived from the requirements baseline.
criteria: The document follows its DRD section by section; the PDR accepts it.
notes: file=TS; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex D; reviews=PDR; path=ecss/TS/SRS.md

title: Interface control document (ICD)
body: The library's interface toward kyr_core and every consumer: the header's constant, type and eight functions, the build-time switches, the shared object's soname and exports, the packages.
criteria: The document follows its DRD section by section; the PDR accepts it.
notes: file=TS; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex E; reviews=PDR; path=ecss/TS/ICD.md

title: Software design document (SDD)
body: The design of app/mpscring.c: the control block and its cache lines, the slots and their sequences, the storage layout and its slack, the producers' claim and publish, the consumer's take, the test seams; the decisions and their reasons; the diagrams.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the PDR accepts the architecture.
notes: file=DDF; drd=ECSS-E-ST-40 Annex F; reviews=PDR,CDR; path=ecss/DDF/SDD.md

title: API reference of mpscring.h (from the code, by Doxygen)
body: Every constant, type and function of app/mpscring.h with its parameters, returns, thread-safety notes and the tests that call it, written from Doxygen's XML of the release commit; the call, caller and include graphs beside it.
rationale: The header is the interface; its reference is generated from it so that the two never differ.
criteria: Generated from the release commit; the CDR accepts it.

title: Software user manual (SUM)
body: How a consumer builds against MPSCring, creates a ring in its own or the library's storage, pushes from many threads, pops from one, handles a full or an empty ring, lives with the stalled-producer window and tears the ring down.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the CDR accepts it.

title: Software validation specification w.r.t. the TS (SVS)
body: The cases: the release pipeline's suites and gates grouped by what they prove, the inspection of the sequence protocol and the memory ordering, each with its criteria and the requirements it verifies.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the CDR accepts it.

title: Software verification report (SVR)
body: The release pipeline run at 73bb6fe3 (1.0.10): every stage, every suite's count, the coverage, the stress figures, the evidence logs; what was not run and why; the verification status of each requirement.
criteria: The document follows its DRD; the QR accepts it.
